summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Plume Suites boutique hotel site. 6/6 backend pytest tests pass (journal list/detail/404, contact POST/GET, email validation). 13/13 frontend flows pass: home, sejours list with both suites, suite detail pages with CTA, art-de-vivre, journal with 5 cards, journal article body, contact form submission with success message, FR/EN language switch, navbar transparent->bg-ink on scroll, mobile hamburger menu.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo but the response model is datetime — works because Pydantic coerces on read. Acceptable but consider storing native BSON datetime for index/sort correctness on large datasets.
GET /api/contact has no auth — exposes all submitted messages publicly. For production, add admin auth before exposing.
CORS_ORIGINS is '*' which is fine for dev but should be locked down for production.
Journal articles are hardcoded in server.py (~140 lines). For a CMS-style approach later, consider moving to a separate journal_data.py or MongoDB collection so server.py stays lean.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed contact_messages entries in MongoDB via POST /api/contact during tests. Non-destructive; can be cleaned manually if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py cover journal + contact endpoints fully. Use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Navbar root has data-testid='main-navbar' (header element) — note that a child nav element exists too, so always select by data-testid. All suite/journal cards expose data-testid (sejours-suite-douceur, sejours-suite-envolee, journal-card-{slug}, journal-page, home-page, art-de-vivre-page, contact-name/email/subject/message/submit, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, lang-fr/lang-en).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Initial transient false-negative on navbar scroll test was due to my selector falling back to inner <nav> (desktop links list, data-testid=None) instead of the root <header data-testid='main-navbar'>. Verified separately: root header class transitions from 'bg-transparent' to 'bg-ink' (computed bg rgb(59,49,43) = #3b312b) on scroll. Behavior matches spec.
